title: ASP.NET Practicals (1 to 9)
description: Interactive demos of all 9 ASP.NET practicals — run them live in your browser.

practicals.title: Hello World
practicals.description: Create a first ASP.NET Website and display Hello World.

practicals.title: Page Load Event
practicals.description: Write an ASP.NET program to display 'Hello World' on page load event.

practicals.title: Label Control
practicals.description: Write an ASP.NET program to display a text in Label control on form load event.

practicals.title: Button Click
practicals.description: Write an ASP.NET program to display a text in Label control on Button click event.
practicals.aspxCode:
<asp:Button ID="btnClick" runat="server" Text="Click Me" OnClick="btnClick_Click" />
<asp:Label ID="lblMessage" runat="server"></asp:Label>

practicals.title: String Concatenation
practicals.description: Write an ASP.NET program to take two string values from user, concatenate them and display.
practicals.aspxCode:
<asp:TextBox ID="txtString1" runat="server"></asp:TextBox>
<asp:TextBox ID="txtString2" runat="server"></asp:TextBox>
<asp:Button ID="btnConcat" runat="server" Text="Concatenate" OnClick="btnConcat_Click" />
<asp:Label ID="lblResult" runat="server"></asp:Label>

practicals.title: Power Calculator (a^b)
practicals.description: Write an ASP.NET program to calculate a^b.
practicals.aspxCode:
<asp:TextBox ID="txtA" runat="server"></asp:TextBox>
<asp:TextBox ID="txtB" runat="server"></asp:TextBox>
<asp:Button ID="btnCalculate" runat="server" Text="Calculate a^b" OnClick="btnCalculate_Click" />
<asp:Label ID="lblResult" runat="server"></asp:Label>

practicals.title: Marks Calculator
practicals.description: Write an ASP.NET program to calculate total marks and average of 3 subjects.
practicals.aspxCode:
<asp:TextBox ID="txtSubject1" runat="server"></asp:TextBox>
<asp:TextBox ID="txtSubject2" runat="server"></asp:TextBox>
<asp:TextBox ID="txtSubject3" runat="server"></asp:TextBox>
<asp:Button ID="btnCalculate" runat="server" Text="Calculate" OnClick="btnCalculate_Click" />
<asp:Label ID="lblResult" runat="server"></asp:Label>

practicals.title: Feedback/Testimonial
practicals.description: Write an ASP.NET program to take user feedback (Name, Email, Message) and display it.
practicals.aspxCode:
<asp:TextBox ID="txtName" runat="server"></asp:TextBox>
<asp:TextBox ID="txtEmail" runat="server"></asp:TextBox>
<asp:TextBox ID="txtMessage" runat="server" TextMode="MultiLine"></asp:TextBox>
<asp:Button ID="btnSubmit" runat="server" Text="Submit" OnClick="btnSubmit_Click" />
<asp:Label ID="lblOutput" runat="server"></asp:Label>

practicals.title: File Upload
practicals.description: Write an ASP.NET program to upload a file.
practicals.aspxCode:
<asp:FileUpload ID="fileUpload" runat="server" />
<asp:Button ID="btnUpload" runat="server" Text="Upload" OnClick="btnUpload_Click" />
<asp:Label ID="lblMessage" runat="server"></asp:Label>
